set.descent_text: The technical climbing ends just below the top, and a short scramble reaches the summit. From there the way down is brief: a few minutes of walking and easy downclimbing returns to the saddle between Dome and Chickamin Peaks, where parties camp on snow beside the Dome Glacier. From camp, one way out runs down the Dome Glacier to Cub Lake, over Cub Pass, and down the headwaters of Bachelor Creek to the Downey Creek trail.

review.notes: First-ascent report: technical climbing ends, scramble to summit, descent to the col camp under 5 minutes; camp is at the Dome/Chickamin col reached via Bachelor Creek, Cub Pass, Cub Lake and the Dome Glacier. Exit path is the reverse of the approach.
